messages:
alex: FYI post-incident follow-up. Cost-first routing picked a low-cost variant and p99 spiked. We need a small, practical signal contract to avoid repeats.

maya: Agreed. We should require a minimal safety signal. Proposal: runtime.safety_score (0-1) and runtime.probe_p99_ms + runtime.signal_ts. Treat missing as conservative.

sam: Also add a short TTL and aging: if signal_ts older than 12s, decay safety_score toward 0.2. That prevents stale probes from masking load.

eli: Implementation approach: add a policy-compiler adapter to normalize per-runtime fields to canonical names. Adapter can map legacy metrics so we can roll without touching every runtime.

jordan: Policy rule sketch: prefer same-region if safety_score>=0.6 and probe_p99_ms<=320; else if safety_score>=0.4 and cost_delta<=0.15 try primary; otherwise hedge to N=1 preferring latency up to cost_cap=0.3.

rachel: Console UX: preview normalized signals and simulated decisions for a selected window. Also expose per-tenant opt-in for cost-aggressive mode with egress estimate.

maya: Tests: add sim scenarios: stale-probe, sudden p99 spike, and gradual cross-region egress. Measure request latency, hedge_count, and cost delta.

sam: Backwards compatibility: runtimes that don't emit fields get safety_score=0.33, probe_p99_ms=9999, signal_ts=now-60s. Document in SDK.

eli: Ops: I'll run a 30d sim once we publish the mapping table. We need that to estimate egress impact.
jordan: Ops-bot: create alerts for region.safety_drop (30% drop) and routing.hedge_spike.

ops-bot: @jordan created alert: "region.safety_drop" threshold=30% window=60s. Runbook: follow regional-capacity playbook and consider temporary hedging override.

alex: Action items: eli -> mapping doc (ETA Wed); sam -> unit tests + sim job (ETA Thu); maya -> RFC follow-up + rollout note (ETA Tue); rachel -> console preview mock (ETA Mon). Keep hedging opt-in until sims validate defaults.

maya: One tradeoff: hedging raises egress costs. Optimize must provide per-tenant simulation and a guardrail option.

alex: Agreed. We'll be conservative on global defaults until sims look good. Thanks all.
